scientific_integrity: Proof is analytical; finite numerical checks serve as corroboration only. All cited public-source dates denote earliest verified public preprint releases; no independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Global convergence applies to an uncorrected fixed-step epsilon-outside RMSProp recursion, with beta strictly between 0 and 1, strong convexity and global L-smoothness. The inverse-time and squared-memory limits require a scalar quadratic and nonterminating position iterates. No general multivariate rate, stochastic statement, or finite-transient uniformity is claimed. Priority checks on inspected literature are not an independent audit.
title: Global stability and universal critical slowdown of epsilon-outside RMSProp
